meetings.title: Expo planning sync
transcript: Maya: Booth 412 is confirmed. Fifteen days. Sam, what does the demo look like?
Sam: Three screens. A carrier books a slot, Smart Slots suggests a better one, and the dock manager watches the load even out. I need realistic sample data.
Jordan: Coastal said we can use an anonymized week of their bookings. I'll get it from Grace today.
Maya: Perfect. How many booth meetings can we book?
Jordan: Forty leads on the list. Invites go out Friday like we planned.
Maya: I'm still pushing Pinecrest to be the third design partner. If they sign this week, we hit the launch goal.
Sam: Printed screens at the booth, or just the live demo?
Maya: Live demo, with a printed one-pager as backup.
